canonical_target.accepted_name: Dinebra panicea subsp. mucronata (Michx.) P.M.Peterson & N.Snow
canonical_target.duplicate_guard: Map historical aliases to existing subspecies; do not collapse separately accepted D. panicea subsp. brachiata or subsp. panicea.

authority_backbone: Kew Plants of the World Online / WCVP (accessed 2026-10-25)
primary_research: Peterson, Romaschenko, Snow & Johnson 2012, Annals of Botany 109:1317-1330, doi:10.1093/aob/mcs077

decisions.subject: Dinebra panicea subsp. mucronata
decisions.decision: Accepted Poaceae subspecies, not independently accepted species; author (Michx.) P.M.Peterson & N.Snow; published Annals of Botany 109:1326 (2012).

decisions.subject: Dinebra panicea (Retz.) P.M.Peterson & N.Snow
decisions.decision: Accepted parent species; subspecies mucronata is nested within it.

decisions.subject: Eleusine mucronata Michx.
decisions.decision: Homotypic basionym of D. panicea subsp. mucronata.

decisions.subject: Leptochloa mucronata (Michx.) Kunth
decisions.decision: Homotypic synonym of accepted D. panicea subsp. mucronata.

decisions.subject: Leptochloa panicea subsp. mucronata (Michx.) Nowack
decisions.decision: Homotypic synonym at subspecies rank; not an additional accepted subspecies.

decisions.subject: Dinebra panicea var. mucronata (Michx.) P.M.Peterson & N.Snow
decisions.decision: Homotypic synonym at variety rank, distinct from accepted subspecies rank.

decisions.subject: Leptochloa filiformis (Pers.) P.Beauv.
decisions.decision: Heterotypic synonym placed under D. panicea subsp. mucronata in POWO/WCVP; source-labelled historical specimens still require identity review.

decisions.subject: Leptochloa attenuata (Nutt.) Steud.
decisions.decision: Heterotypic synonym placed under D. panicea subsp. mucronata by POWO/WCVP.

decisions.subject: Dinebra panicea subsp. brachiata (Steud.) P.M.Peterson & N.Snow
decisions.decision: Separately accepted subspecies under D. panicea, not a synonym of subsp. mucronata.

decisions.subject: 2012 Leptochloa s.l. phylogeny
decisions.decision: Molecular revision supports Dinebra as a genus distinct from Leptochloa s.s.; 2012 accepted combinations follow this split.

decisions.subject: blanket merge of subsp. brachiata into subsp. mucronata
decisions.decision: Reject: POWO/WCVP accepts both subspecies separately. Do not transfer photos or specimen labels between them.

decisions.subject: Leptochloa mucronata as separately accepted learner species
decisions.decision: Reject under POWO/WCVP backbone: synonym of the existing Dinebra panicea subsp. mucronata concept; no duplicate learner entry.

decisions.subject: individual photo/specimen determination at subspecies rank
decisions.decision: Canonical gallery metadata and images have not been independently authenticated to subspecies from diagnostic vouchers in this taxonomy-only pass. Retain original photo and science holds.

decisions.subject: hybrid ancestry for any individual Dinebra specimen
decisions.decision: No source in this audit establishes hybrid ancestry for any learner image or specimen; do not infer a hybrid formula or clear identity holds.

decisions.subject: historical Leptochloa filiformis specimen concepts
decisions.decision: Synonym mapping does not independently certify every historical specimen carrying this heterotypic name. Voucher-by-voucher review remains necessary.

decisions.subject: generic Dinebra panicea or Leptochloa panicea source labels
decisions.decision: Species-rank historical source labels alone do not prove subsp. mucronata rather than accepted subsp. brachiata or subsp. panicea.

handoff.name_authority_field: Canonical authority is blank; taxonomic evidence records correct author, but card modification is outside this lane.
handoff.source_concept: Use only taxon-specific vouchered morphology for subspecies photo certification. Source-level D. panicea names are insufficient.
handoff.scientific_review: Accepted taxon name/rank verified in this evidence file; canonical taxonomy_reviewed flag deliberately unchanged.
